grid_drift_ms.note: Kick attack minus constant-tempo reference beat. The song drifts against a fixed BPM; use start_s (kick-locked) for motion accents. Bar numbers are unchanged.

method.grid: beat_reference.json bar/beat numbering; each beat moved to the kick-band flux peak within +-100 ms, median over +-4 locked beats, linear through unlocked gaps. 16 equal steps between locked beats.
method.drums: Drum stem, 22.05 kHz, STFT 1024/128, log flux. kick (30, 150) Hz. clap/snare = (400, 1500) Hz flux minus the local kick-only ratio x kick flux at kick steps, minus local hat leakage elsewhere. hat = (5000, 11000) Hz minus the local kick ratio at kick steps. Per-step peak in (-0.03, 0.045) s. x = above the band song-wide Otsu threshold (log; clap floor 20); X = above max(2x threshold, p95). backbeat = mean clap excess on steps 4,12 minus steps 0,8; hints use its median over +-2 drum bars (>=15). Per-step clap marks are noisy bar to bar: trust backbeat and section-level patterns more than a single x.
method.hats_on_beats: Hat marks ON beats (steps 0,4,8,12) are unreliable: the kick correction can hide a hat that coincides with the kick. Off-beat hat marks are reliable.
method.swing: Median timing of hat hits on odd 16th steps minus even steps, in the same bar; ratio = (q+d)/(q-d), q = 16th.
method.bass: pYIN 38-400 Hz on the bass stem at 11.025 kHz; median voiced MIDI per beat. pump depth = median over beats of 1 - p10/p90 RMS within the beat; >=.55 pumping, <=.30 sustained, else plucked; none if 24 dB below the p95 level.
method.energy_brightness: Full-mix RMS and spectral centroid, bar means, ranked to 0-1 between the song 5th and 95th percentiles.
method.vocals: Owner manual syllable onsets (syllables.json) counted per kick-locked bar; lines = phrase_windows planning_range overlaps.
method.fill_stop: fill: >=2 kick/clap hits on steps 13-15, or >=3 clap steps in beat 4 well above beats 1-3. stop: kick on 1,2,3 but no kick/clap in beat 4. WEAK detector.
method.section_change: Novelty = distance between z-scored feature means of the 2 bars before and the 2 bars from this bar; local peaks above the song 85th percentile.
method.hint: Deterministic rules in groove_sheet.hint(); a starting point for choreography, not a listening judgement.
